```{r codeCreatePOLts, include=FALSE}
## Check politics across all attitudes --------------


## AGE ----
## Monthly frequencies
age.poldems <- as.data.frame(table(timeseriesAge$politicalid, timeseriesAge$month.cent))
colnames(age.poldems) <- c("pol", "month", "freq")
age.poldems$month <- as.numeric(as.character(age.poldems$month))
age.poldems_wide <- reshape(age.poldems, v.names = "freq", 
                       timevar = "month", idvar = "pol",
                       direction = "wide")

age.poldems_NEW <- as.data.frame(table(timeseriesAge_NEW$politicalid.new, timeseriesAge_NEW$month.cent))
colnames(age.poldems_NEW) <- c("pol", "month", "freq")
age.poldems_NEW$month <- as.numeric(as.character(age.poldems_NEW$month)) + 156
age.poldems_NEW$pol <- factor(age.poldems_NEW$pol, labels = levels(age.poldems$pol))
age.poldems_NEWwide <- reshape(age.poldems_NEW, v.names = "freq", 
                       timevar = "month", idvar = "pol",
                       direction = "wide")
age.poldems <- rbind(age.poldems, age.poldems_NEW)
age.poldems_wide <- cbind(age.poldems_wide, age.poldems_NEWwide[,-1])
age.poldems_wideN <- colSums(age.poldems_wide[,-1])
age.poldems_wide[,-1] <- sweep(age.poldems_wide[,-1], 2, age.poldems_wideN, FUN = '/')


plot(age.poldems$freq[age.poldems$pol == "Strongly Conservative"],
     type = "l", ylab = "Frequency", xlab = "Month Index", col = "darkred",
     ylim = c(0, 5000))
lines(age.poldems$freq[age.poldems$pol == "Moderately Conservative"], col = "red")
lines(age.poldems$freq[age.poldems$pol == "Slightly Conservative"], col = "salmon")
lines(age.poldems$freq[age.poldems$pol == "Strongly Liberal"], col = "darkblue")
lines(age.poldems$freq[age.poldems$pol == "Moderately Liberal"], col = "blue")
lines(age.poldems$freq[age.poldems$pol == "Slightly Conservative"], col = "cadetblue")
lines(age.poldems$freq[age.poldems$pol == "Neutral"], col = "black")
legend("topleft", c("Strongly Conservative", "Moderately Conservative", "Slightly Conservative",
                    "Slightly Liberal", "Moderately Liberal", "Strongly Liberal", "Neutral"),
       col = c("darkred", "red", "salmon", "darkblue", "blue", "cadetblue", "black"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

plot(x = 1:c(ncol(age.poldems_wide)-1), y = as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[1,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]),
     type = "l", ylab = "Relative Frequency", xlab = "", col = "darkred",
     ylim = c(0, 0.6), axes = FALSE)
box()
axis(1, at = seq(1, 169, by = 12), labels = c(2007:2021))
axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.6, by = 0.1), labels = seq(0, 0.6, by = 0.1))
lines(as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[2,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]), col = "red")
lines(as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[3,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]), col = "salmon")
lines(as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[7,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]), col = "darkblue")
lines(as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[6,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]), col = "blue")
lines(as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[5,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]), col = "cadetblue")
lines(as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[4,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]), col = "black")
legend("topleft", c("Strongly Conservative", "Moderately Conservative", "Slightly Conservative",
                    "Slightly Liberal", "Moderately Liberal", "Strongly Liberal", "Neutral"),
       col = c("darkred", "red", "salmon", "darkblue", "blue", "cadetblue", "black"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

age.corpol <- list()
age.corpoldat <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 7, ncol = 4))
colnames(age.corpoldat) <- c("att", "grp", "r", "p")
age.corpoldat$att <- "age"
age.corpoldat$grp <- age.poldems_wide$pol

for (i in 1:7){
  age.corpol[[i]] <- cor.test(as.numeric(age.poldems_wide[i,2:ncol(age.poldems_wide)]), 1:c(ncol(age.poldems_wide)-1)) # correlation w/ Strongly conservative
  age.corpoldat$r[i] <- age.corpol[[i]]$estimate
  age.corpoldat$p[i] <- age.corpol[[i]]$p.value
}

                    "Slightly Liberal", "Moderately Liberal", "Strongly Liberal", "Neutral"),
       col = c("darkred", "red", "salmon", "darkblue", "blue", "cadetblue", "black"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

plot(x = 1:c(ncol(sex.poldems_wide)-1), y = as.numeric(sex.poldems_wide[1,2:ncol(sex.poldems_wide)]),
     type = "l", ylab = "Relative Frequency", xlab = "", col = "darkred",
     ylim = c(0, 0.6), axes = FALSE)
box()
axis(1, at = seq(1, 169, by = 12), labels = c(2007:2021))
axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.6, by = 0.1), labels = seq(0, 0.6, by = 0.1))

lines(as.numeric(sex.poldems_wide[7,2:ncol(sex.poldems_wide)]), col = "darkblue")
lines(as.numeric(sex.poldems_wide[6,2:ncol(sex.poldems_wide)]), col = "blue")
lines(as.numeric(sex.poldems_wide[5,2:ncol(sex.poldems_wide)]), col = "cadetblue")

                    "Slightly Liberal", "Moderately Liberal", "Strongly Liberal", "Neutral"),
       col = c("darkred", "red", "salmon", "darkblue", "blue", "cadetblue", "black"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

sex.corpol <- list()
sex.corpoldat <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 7, ncol = 4))
colnames(sex.corpoldat) <- c("att", "grp", "r", "p")
sex.corpoldat$att <- "sex"
sex.corpoldat$grp <- sex.poldems_wide$pol

for (i in 1:7){
  sex.corpol[[i]] <- cor.test(as.numeric(sex.poldems_wide[i,2:ncol(sex.poldems_wide)]), 1:c(ncol(sex.poldems_wide)-1)) # correlation w/ Strongly conservative
  sex.corpoldat$r[i] <- sex.corpol[[i]]$estimate
  sex.corpoldat$p[i] <- sex.corpol[[i]]$p.value
}

sex.corpoldat
```

```{r tablOutput, echo=FALSE}
## CREATE TABLE ----
demchanges_table <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 6*7, ncol = 6))
colnames(demchanges_table) <- c("att", "grp", "r", "p", "startprop", "endprop")
demchanges_table$att <- rep(c("Age", "Race", "Skin-tone", "Sexuality", "Disability", "Weight"), each = 7)
demchanges_table$grp <- rep(c("Strongly Conservative", "Moderately Conservative", "Slightly Conservative", "Neutral",
                               "Slightly Liberal", "Moderately Liberal", "Strongly Liberal"), times = 6)

demchanges_table$r <- round(c(age.corpoldat$r, race.corpoldat$r, skin.corpoldat$r, sex.corpoldat$r,
                              dis.corpoldat$r, weight.corpoldat$r), 2) 
demchanges_table$p <- round(c(age.corpoldat$p, race.corpoldat$p, skin.corpoldat$p, sex.corpoldat$p,
                              dis.corpoldat$p, weight.corpoldat$p), 3)

demchanges_table$startprop <-round(c(as.numeric(age.poldems_year_wide[1:7,2]), as.numeric(race.poldems_year_wide[1:7,2]),
                                     as.numeric(skin.poldems_year_wide[1:7,2]), as.numeric(sex.poldems_year_wide[1:7,2]),
                                     as.numeric(dis.poldems_year_wide[1:7,2]), as.numeric(weight.poldems_year_wide[1:7,2])), 3)
demchanges_table$endprop <-round(c(as.numeric(age.poldems_year_wide[1:7,15]), as.numeric(race.poldems_year_wide[1:7,15]),
                                     as.numeric(skin.poldems_year_wide[1:7,15]), as.numeric(sex.poldems_year_wide[1:7,15]),
                                     as.numeric(dis.poldems_year_wide[1:7,15]), as.numeric(weight.poldems_year_wide[1:7,12])), 3)

knitr::kable(demchanges_table,
             col.names = c("Attitude", "Group", "Correlation w Time", "p of Correlation",
                           "Starting Proportion (2007)", "Ending Proportion (2020)"))
```
